author: KEXP
description: Melbourne, Australia's Dirty Three deliver emotionally charged, pictorially evocative instrumental music in our latest in-studio session. Live on KEXP, the trio share a performance of "Love Changes Everything II" and more.
title: Dirty Three performs "Love Changes Everything II" & more Live on KEXP
